adversarialFindings.description: The immutable release gate invokes project-wide TypeScript validation, which fails on accepted B3 test code because e2e/b3-hub-map-visual-review.spec.ts references indexedDB directly while the E2E TypeScript project intentionally has no DOM globals.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Use a narrow IndexedDbBrowserScope structural type and access browser IndexedDB through globalThis inside page.evaluate. This is test-typing only and preserves the same runtime fixture behavior.

B-final addresses only those debts and refreshes stale release-review evidence; no product/runtime/UI change is introduced. Existing physical-device, manual screen-reader, independent CI, and hosted-origin publication prerequisites remain in force.
